title: Bluebottle Miniwave Deploy Canvas and Postmortem Template - May 2026 (draft)
content:
Purpose:
This is a working deploy canvas for the Bluebottle feature miniwave (customer-facing ranking changes + batching improvement). The doc is intentionally compact: quick calendar, operational checklist, rollback criteria, and a post-release notes template. Use during preflight and keep concise in shift handoff.

Goals:
- Launch Bluebottle tiered deployment to 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h windows with telemetry gates.
- Validate latency P95 delta < 12ms and error budget draw < 2% relative to baseline.
- Ensure quick rollback path with minimal consumer impact.

Scope (what's in / out):
- Included: model-serving change (request batching), routing rule to Bluebottle model variant, telemetry flags, canary config.
- Excluded: client SDK changes (shipping later), UI toggles.

Primary contacts:
- Release lead: Priya Nair (pager: priya@redwood.ai)
- SRE lead: Samir Patel (on-call pager)
- Observability: Ava Chen (dashboards, alerts)
- Engagement / CS liaison: Lena Fischer

Channels / references:
- Slack: #release-bluebottle, #sre-oncall
- Pager duty play: release-oncall -> Samir Patel
- Confluence spec: linked above
- Preflight checklist RFC: GH PR infra/1284

High-level rollout calendar (compact):
- T-72h: Final integration smoke and preflight signals run (priority tests, load generator). Owners: infra, serving-runtime.
- T-48h: Lock feature flag, freeze non-essential merges. Notify GTM + CS.
- T-24h: Dry-run deploy to staging miniwave; confirm telemetry ingestion and KV cache behavior.
- Day 0, 10:00 UTC: Deploy to prod cluster behind traffic router, enable 5% traffic slice. Start 12h observation window.
- Day 0, 22:00 UTC: If green, bump to 15% with 12h hold.
- Day 1, 10:00 UTC: If green, bump to 25% and run overnight soak (24h).
- Day 2: Final 100% ramp if no regressions and post-rollout checks pass.

Preflight checklist (must be green before T-24h):
- [ ] All PRs merged and CI green (list PRs in linked_artifacts).
- [ ] Smoke tests for batching path pass locally and in staging (serving-runtime team).
- [ ] Observe KV cache warmup behavior in staging (logs + traces).
- [ ] Canary dashboards provisioned: latency, errors, token cost, tail latency.
- [ ] Alerts defined and validated: latency-surge, error-rate > 0.5%, model-fallbacks.
- [ ] Rollback playbook drafted and reviewed by SRE and Release lead.
- [ ] Communication plan drafted for CS, GTM, legal as needed.
- [ ] Backfill capacity plan (burst lanes) reviewed with infra.

Quiet-window escrow steps (special handling for consumer-impact changes):
- Establish quiet-hours: Day 0 00:00-06:00 UTC blackout for non-critical changes; Bluebottle ramp targets avoid blackout crossing.
- Consumer-impact grid: annotate endpoints affected, expected RPS change, and user-visible risk (low/med/high). For Bluebottle: embeddings endpoint unaffected; text-gen endpoints low risk.
- Escrowed artifacts: copy of pre-deploy model binaries, routing config snapshot, and server-side feature flags. Stored in release bucket with access limited to release group.

Traffic ramp specifics and guardrails:
- Ramp increments: 0% -> 5% -> 15% -> 25% -> 100% (final only after 48h of green signals).
- Automatic rollback triggers (actioned immediately):
  - error-rate > 0.8% absolute OR > 3x baseline for 5m rolling window.
  - P95 latency delta > 25ms sustained for 10m and P99 spikes correlate with model variant.
  - Token-cost per request increases > 15% and persists after 30m.
- Manual rollback triggers: SEV alerts, customer escalations, or telemetry anomalies not captured above.

Rollback procedure (quick):
- Step 1: Pause new Bluebottle router rules (release lead).
- Step 2: Switch traffic slices back to baseline model variant (infra runbook command: deploy-router rollback --tag baseline).
- Step 3: Monitor priority gauges for 30 minutes; escalate if rollback fails or if we see persistent downstream errors.
- Step 4: Open postmortem stub and assign initial incident owner.

Telemetry and observability (must be verified):
- Dashboards: bluebottle/latency-p95, bluebottle/error-rate, bluebottle/token-cost, bluebottle-kvcache-hitrate.
- Traces: sample traces where P95 regresses; tag with variant=bluebottle.
- Logs: structured logs include deploy_id, variant, and request_id.
- Eval sentinel: sample prompt set run at each ramp step; diff against baseline and record quality regressions.

Post-release notes template (fill after final 100% or rollback):
- Release ID: BLUEBOTTLE-MW-2026-05-xx
- Lead: Priya Nair
- SRE: Samir Patel
- Rollout windows and percentages: attach calendar below
- Observed deltas: latency P50/P95/P99, error-rate, token-cost per request (numbers + graphs).
- Incidents: any SEV triggered, time-to-detect, time-to-remediate.
- Lessons learned / follow-ups: owner + ETA.
- Customer impact summary: any reported issues, CS tickets, mitigation steps.

Open questions / risks (notes):
- Does the new batching path change cache localities that will affect other teams? (Ping serving-runtime + platform-engineering).
- Fallback semantics for mixed-model pipelines (some routes call Bluebottle variant, others baseline) need explicit verification.
- Scaling behavior on region-specific fleets: how do we ensure consistent variant availability across EU/US regions?

Action items (owners):
- Priya: final release brief, coordinate with CS (due T-48h).
- Samir: validate rollback scripts and run a dry run (T-72h).
- Ava: provision dashboards and set temporary alert thresholds for ramp windows (T-48h).
- Lena: draft customer-facing note + PS playbook (T-24h).

Appendix: quick commands and checks
- infra check: infra/ops health-check --cluster prod --deploy bluebottle
- rollback: infra/ops deploy-router rollback --tag baseline --reason "auto-rollback"

Notes to self / working comments:
- TODO: add explicit ingress throttles if we see client backpressure in staging.
- TODO: include an example red-team prompt set for eval sentinel (Ava to own).
- Keep this doc short; full runbook will be auto-generated from the release template after final signoff.

-- end of canvas (working draft).
